column1: # Attacks the engine must catch. One per line, TAB separated:
# A category with a leading ~ only has to be flagged (a probe, or a hit under
# 5 points); without it the request must be a payload (5+ points: dropped).
# Spaces in a target are sent as %20 and, in a second run, every query value
# is percent-encoded again: both must be caught.

column2: /p?id=-1' UNION SELECT 1,group_concat(table_name),3 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=database()--+
/p?sort=(case when (1=1) then id else name end)
/p?order=id,(select 1 from(select count(*),concat(version(),floor(rand(0)*2))x from information_schema.tables group by x)a)
